title: Coding with Goose
description: Goose on your project with Anthropic's API (your key stays outside the sandbox), PyPI, npm and GitHub open for the project's packages and code, the agent's memory of this project kept between sessions; everything else stays closed.

de.title: Programmieren mit Goose
de.description: Goose an Ihrem Projekt mit der API von Anthropic (Ihr Schlüssel bleibt außerhalb der Sandbox), PyPI, npm und GitHub offen für die Pakete und den Code des Projekts, das Gedächtnis des Agenten zu diesem Projekt bleibt zwischen den Sitzungen; alles andere bleibt zu.

notes: The model: Anthropic's API with your key (sandbox-ai secrets set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY once). Goose sees a placeholder, the connection proxy puts the key in on the wire, and Goose starts with its provider anthropic (its model: --model NAME, or goose configure in the sandbox). Another provider: --api-key api.openai.com=OPENAI_API_KEY or openrouter.ai=OPENROUTER_API_KEY, or a model server of yours with --llm (the preset goose-local-llm).
PyPI, npm and GitHub are open for the project's dependencies; everything else is refused or asked (--ask). Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
Memory: ~/.config/goose/AGENTS.md (Goose's global hints) belongs to this project only and is kept between runs (not with --no-memory); the agent keeps its notes about the project there.

Goose asks before it changes something (its mode smart_approve); -D gives it its own default, auto. Its scheduler, Telegram gateway, local models, model catalog and updates stay off unless --goose-enable names them.
Goose's telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on (its opt-out variables are set and the proxy refuses PostHog).
Its image first: sandbox-ai build goose.
